## Use Cases

- Full-stack web development with ASP.NET and React/Vue/Angular
- Blazor applications with Node.js build tooling
- Microservices with .NET backends and Node.js frontends
- API development with .NET and TypeScript client generation

## Containerfile

The Containerfile is shared across all templates. It provides:

1. UBI9 base image pinned by digest
2. Non-root `dev` user (UID 1001)
3. uv pre-installed for feature bootstrap

```dockerfile
FROM ghcr.io/infrashift/trusted-base-images/trusted/ubi9-standard@sha256:f938c...

ARG USERNAME=dev
ARG USER_UID=1001
ARG USER_GID=1001
```

See [Containerfile Sync](/trusted-devcontainer-templates/pipeline/containerfile-sync/) for how consistency is enforced.
